summary.method: Independent manual inspection of title and full abstract against the prespecified rubric

audited_records.title: The BP catastrophe and sociological practice mitigating community impacts through peer-listener training
audited_records.rationale: Suicide is contextual motivation for a broad disaster mental-health intervention and is not distinctly analyzed.

audited_records.title: Gender Differences in the Pathways from Sexual Abuse to Risky Sexual Behavior in Homeless Youth
audited_records.rationale: Suicidal ideation is included in regression as an analyzed mechanism and has a separately reported significant association.

audited_records.title: Enhanced Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT-E) as an Intervention for BIPOC Adolescent Girls with Eating Disorders
audited_records.rationale: Suicidality appears only in background on eating-disorder mortality; the article argues for culturally responsive eating-disorder treatment.

audited_records.title: Constructing the Modern Worker: The Occluded Origins of Clinical Social Work
audited_records.rationale: The phrase race suicide is a historical demographic ideology, not suicide or suicidal behavior.

audited_records.title: HIV/AIDS and suicide: Be open
audited_records.rationale: The title is centrally about HIV/AIDS and suicide; no abstract establishes an empirical design, so the conservative title-only rule applies.

audited_records.title: Suicide: Foucault, History and Truth
audited_records.rationale: The title is centrally about suicide and Foucauldian history; no abstract establishes an empirical design.

audited_records.title: Evidence-based gatekeeper suicide prevention in a small community context
audited_records.rationale: Suicide-prevention programs are central, but the abstract does not describe a systematic, scoping, or meta-analytic search and selection method.

audited_records.title: Suicide among individuals with schizophrenia: A risk factor model
audited_records.rationale: The paper centrally develops a conceptual suicide-risk model without analyzing new observations or conducting a systematic review.

audited_records.title: Mapping Suicide Mortality in Ohio: A Spatial Epidemiological Analysis of Suicide Clusters and Area Level Correlates
audited_records.rationale: The study uses death records, spatial statistics, principal components, and regression to analyze suicide clusters.

audited_records.title: Exploring Suicide Risk Among Homeless Adults in Texas: Investigating Factors Influencing Suicide Ideation and the Need for Safety Planning
audited_records.rationale: Suicide ideation is the stated outcome in a multivariable logistic-regression study.

audited_records.title: Understanding the Role of Peer Victimization As an Adverse Childhood Experience in Predicting Behavior Problems across Racial/Ethnic Groups
audited_records.rationale: Suicidal ideation and attempts are explicit dependent variables analyzed using weighted logistic regression.

audited_records.title: Military Providers' Attitudes Towards Assessing and Treating Suicidality
audited_records.rationale: Provider suicide-assessment attitudes and practices are measured by survey and analyzed with regression.

audited_records.title: Growing www.parentsofsuicide: A Case Study of an online support community
audited_records.rationale: The article reports case-study findings on an online community for parents bereaved by suicide.

audited_records.title: Personal and Professional Knowledge of and Experience With Suicide and Suicide Prevention Among Stakeholders in Clinical and Community Practice
audited_records.rationale: The abstract explicitly reports qualitative interview data on providers' suicide experience and responses.

audited_records.title: No One Theory of Suicide: The Experience of a Cancer Patient Who Killed Himself
audited_records.rationale: The study uses a phenomenological psychological autopsy to analyze a suicide case.

audited_records.title: An Exploration of Knowledge and Attitudes about Victims or Survivors of Domestic Violence with Mental Health Disability: Perspectives from Domestic Violence Service Providers
audited_records.rationale: Suicide and self-harm are minor items within a broader needs assessment of domestic-violence services and are not distinctly analyzed.

audited_records.title: Dead inside: A Systematic Review of the Psychosocial Effects of Combat-Related Emotional Numbing
audited_records.rationale: This PRISMA-guided systematic review distinctly reports suicidality as one psychosocial outcome domain.

audited_records.title: Empirically Evaluated Suicide Prevention Program Approaches for Older Adults: A Review of the Literature from 2009-2021
audited_records.rationale: The suicide-prevention review explicitly uses PICO, PRISMA, predefined selection, and GRADE assessment.

audited_records.title: Peer-support groups for suicide loss survivors: a systematic review
audited_records.rationale: The suicide-loss intervention review reports a registered systematic search, study selection, synthesis, and bias assessment.

audited_records.title: Screening and Assessment of Suicidal Behavior in Transition-Age Youth with Foster Care Involvement
audited_records.rationale: The suicide-screening paper uses a database search and predefined inclusion criteria to synthesize assessment tools.
